viewsWelcome.contents:
Start with one guided setup, then use the course hub for modules, practice, hands-on work, local progress, and Canvas. Detailed controls stay under Advanced Setup and Diagnostics.
[Set up or repair my course environment](command:systemstudioOs.setupCourseEnvironment)
[Open Learning Hub](command:systemstudioOs.openLearningHub)
[Ask Orbit AI learning coach](command:systemstudioOs.openAiTutor)
[Open Canvas](command:systemstudioOs.openCanvas)

systemstudioOs.canvasCourseUrl.description: Optional override for the verified Fall 2026 Canvas course URL (course 552201). Leave blank to use the bundled verified link.

systemstudioOs.canvasDiscussionUrl.description: Optional verified Canvas discussion URL for pre-class questions. The extension only copies a draft and opens this page.

systemstudioOs.canvasPrivateMessageUrl.description: Optional verified Canvas Inbox or course-contact URL for private pre-class questions.

systemstudioOs.maizeyTutorUrl.description: Optional published student-facing U-M Maizey App/share URL for CIS 450 / ECE 478. Project overview, data-source, settings, and billing URLs are rejected.

scripts.package:portable: npm run check:portable && npx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies && npm run audit:vsix
